name: job-finder
description: Node.js/Express job scraper + daily LinkedIn outreach email system, with a Next.js UI

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "tsx watch src/server.ts" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "node dist/server.js" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w web
